scenes.text: Insta pe *"price?"* comment. Reply kiya, *jawab nahi aaya*?
scenes.say: Boutique owners. Instagram pe price comment aaya. Reply kiya, aur phir jawab nahi aaya?
Price DM kiya. Ye sabse thanda reply hai.

scenes.title: 1. DM mein *ye bhejo*:
scenes.name: Your Boutique

msgs.text: Hi! 💕 Ye suit ₹2,890. Aapke liye *3 colours* 📎📎📎
Size kya hai? *S M L XL* mein se bata dijiye, stock check kar deti hoon.

scenes.say: Price ke saath teen colour ki photos, aur ek aasaan sawaal: size kya hai.

scenes.title: 2. Jawab nahi aaya?
items: *24 ghante* baad: "Maroon M sirf 2 bache hain"
scenes.say: Jawab nahi aaya to chaubees ghante baad ek message, stock ke saath. Sach ho tabhi, aur sirf ek baar.
Raaz ye hai. Aakhri sawaal aasaan rakho. Size kya hai.
Comment karo DM, poori reply script bhejenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
"Price?" comment aaya. Aapne likha "DM kiya 💕". Aur customer gayab. Kyun? Price akela thanda hai. 👗

Business of the Day: Boutique
1️⃣ DM mein price + 3 colour photos
2️⃣ Aasaan sawaal: "Size kya hai?"
3️⃣ Size aaya: stock confirm + "COD ya UPI?"
4️⃣ Jawab nahi? 24 ghante baad ek stock update, sach ho tabhi

Save karo 🔖
Comment "DM" 👇 poori reply script.
